Data extraction: XML nested elements produce child nodes

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"xml\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("<config><host>localhost</host><port>8080</port></config>", config);
        System.out.println(result.data());
    }
}
```
